「Don't tell me that bastard's running away!」

stage0096_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$グラハム$$
「We have to disable him before the time limit...!
　If he just outruns us that long,
　$$アクシズ$$ falls, and he gets what he wants...!」

stage0096_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$カツ$$
「But, resorting to a method like this...!」

stage0096_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That man would never do that...!」

stage0096_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I seek nothing but victory.
　Now that it's come to this, I won't bring
　needless emotion into this fight」

stage0096_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Frustrating as it is, it's a rational move!」

stage0096_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Now I'm certain.
　It was you who sent that assassin after me!」

stage0096_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「If I had finished you off for certain back then,
　perhaps the Supreme Commander wouldn't have had
　to take the field himself」

stage0096_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Let me correct myself, $$フル・フロンタル$$.
　You really aren't $$シャア$$...!
　In fact, you're not even the Red Comet!」

stage0096_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I can't leave the world in the hands
　of a man like you!」

stage0096_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Fine by me.
　I never had any intention of seeking your approval」

stage0096_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I am simply dropping $$アクシズ$$
　to guide the world toward the correct history」

stage0096_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Now then, let us begin anew」

「But at this rate,

stage0096_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Damn it!
　He's sniping us from way over there!」

stage0096_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「That's quite the tactical eye!
　Frustrating as it is...!」

stage0096_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$カトル$$
「If only we could find an opening somewhere...!」

stage0096_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$シャア$$
「Emergency repairs on the $$サザビー$$
　are complete. There's no problem」

stage0096_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$シャア$$
（You have my thanks, $$ナナイ$$）

stage0096_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「What is the meaning of this, Supreme Commander?」

stage0096_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「No... having abandoned the front line,
　the title of Neo Zeon's Supreme Commander
　no longer suits you」

stage0096_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$シャア$$
「You mean to take the Supreme Commander's seat?」

stage0096_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「If there are those who wish that role upon me」

stage0096_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$シャア$$
「Wrong, $$フル・フロンタル$$.
　You are merely playing at $$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　the $$シャア・アズナブル$$ that exists in your mind」

stage0096_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$シャア$$
「What you're trying to do is nothing
　but maintaining the status quo...
　just turning your eyes from reality」

stage0096_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$シャア$$
「And within the flow of time,
　to remain fixed in place is the same
　as being left behind by the era」

stage0096_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$シャア$$
「That is not what people want!」

stage0096_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Is that something for you to decide?」

stage0096_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$シャア$$
「Wrong.
　It's to question that very thing that I moved
　$$アクシズ$$ at this timing」

stage0096_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Don't tell me... timed to coincide
　with the $$エタニティ・フラット$$ announcement...」

stage0096_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$シャア$$
「To unite the minds of the people...
　and by fixing their focus on $$アクシズ$$,
　the Great Singularity, to make the present feel more real...」

stage0096_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$シャア$$
「Above all, it's to recreate the situation
　that seems to have caused the $$新世時空震動$$...
　that is, $$アクシズ$$'s fall, once again」

stage0096_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Quite impressive, $$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　To think you'd considered even that」

stage0096_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「And to see it through, you didn't hesitate
　to become an enemy of your old comrades...
　I salute that extraordinary resolve.」

stage0096_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$シャア$$
「...But the way I chose to achieve it
　was a foolish one...」

stage0096_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「No matter what others may say,
　to walk the path you believe in...
　That is $$シャア・アズナブル$$, the Red Comet, surely.」

stage0096_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$シャア$$
「...You knew a past only I should know.
　And yet, there was a subtle discrepancy in it...」

stage0096_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's exactly the same person existing in one world...
　Proof of being a singularity.」

stage0096_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The same person... is that so...」

stage0096_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$シャア$$
「But the me of now is different from the
　$$シャア・アズナブル$$ that exists inside you.
　The man standing here has met many people, and parted from them.」

stage0096_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「...It's a shame.
　While you are $$シャア・アズナブル$$,
　you are no longer $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

stage0096_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「...The Casval Rem Deikun who exists across many worlds
　has followed many different fates...」

stage0096_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Some fought on as $$クワトロ・バジーナ$$ to the end,
　some in the end became the world's enemy as $$シャア$$,
　and some bowed to aliens to protect humanity...」

stage0096_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「What all of them have in common
　is that your existence was something that decided the shape of the world.」

stage0096_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So that is $$シャア$$'s existence as a singularity...」

stage0096_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Among them, I chose, as the true $$シャア・アズナブル$$,
　to make $$アクシズ$$ fall.
　In other words, I myself am now the Red Comet.」

stage0096_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$シャア$$
「Real or fake, it doesn't matter...!
　I will stop you and carry out $$時空修復$$ here on $$アクシズ$$!」

stage0096_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$シャア$$
「...Right now, I am $$シャア・アズナブル$$.
　A foolish man who chose the method you all despise.」

stage0096_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Did you realize you were a singularity
　after signing the truce with us?」

stage0096_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$シャア$$
「...After the $$新世時空震動$$,
　I began to be plagued by hallucinations and phantom voices.」

stage0096_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$シャア$$
「In them, humanity was constantly in danger,
　and the future was shut in despair...
　It was too vivid to simply call it a nightmare.」

stage0096_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$シン$$
「So you rose as $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　in order to change that...」

stage0096_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「And you used the Zero System
　to learn the meaning of the nightmare you saw...」

stage0096_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$シャア$$
「As a result, I learned that I am something
　of a knot in the tangle of parallel worlds.」

stage0096_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$シャア$$
「At the same time, I realized I was incomplete as a singularity,
　and that $$アクシズ$$ is the Great Singularity.」

stage0096_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$シャア$$
「And I learned that $$フル・フロンタル$$,
　who likewise carries $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s factor,
　is the other singularity.」

stage0096_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$シャア$$
「...And that he would come to walk a different path from mine...」

stage0096_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's why I had no choice
　but to hide that I'd realized I was a singularity.」

stage0096_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$シャア$$
「To keep $$フロンタル$$ in check...
　and at the same time, to keep Geminis and Chrono's movements in check.」

stage0096_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$シャア$$
「Their existence is deeply rooted in the history of mankind.
　And Chrono is an enemy I must defeat.」

stage0096_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$キラ$$
「So that's the truth behind the declaration of war on the Earth Federation...」

stage0096_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Because they're the leaders of the Earth supremacists?」

stage0096_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's right.
　And they were also the mastermind
　behind Zeon Zum Deikun's assassination.」

stage0096_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$リディ$$
「Zeon Zum Deikun...
　the founder of Zeon and the one who advocated Newtypes...」

stage0096_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「They say Zeon Deikun was assassinated
　by the Zabi family, but
　Chrono was behind it all along...」

stage0096_04:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$エマ$$
「Then is Chrono... an organization of $$ＵＣＷ$$ people...
　no, of $$宇宙世紀$$ people?」

stage0096_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$シャア$$
「Not quite.
　Their existence is also tied to the assassination of
　$$ＡＤＷ$$'s $$ヒイロ・ユイ$$, leader of the colony liberation movement.」

stage0096_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$カトル$$
「$$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$...
　Mysterious organizations existing in different worlds...」

stage0096_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'll grant you this much, that you got this far on your own,
　$$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

stage0096_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Seek the box, and you'll arrive at Chrono's existence.」

stage0096_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Laplace's Box is connected to Chrono...!?」

stage0096_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's right, $$バナージ$$.
　That's why I seek the box, to remake this world
　through peaceful means.」

stage0096_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I can't hand that over to someone like you...!」

stage0096_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Look at reality.
　If $$アクシズ$$ falls, the shape of the world will change too.
　And upon that, I will guide the world in the right direction.」

stage0096_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$シャア$$
「I won't let you, $$フロンタル$$...!
　For my own sake too, I will be the one to stop you!」

stage0096_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「There's someone more fitting to be your opponent.」

stage0096_04:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$シャア$$...
　Why did you keep quiet, until today,
　about being a singularity?」

stage0096_04:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Did you think I was the same as $$フル・フロンタル$$...!?」

stage0096_04:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's not it, $$ハマーン$$!
　I wanted to entrust you
　with Neo Zeon after I was gone!」

stage0096_04:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「So in the end, you're leaving me behind!」

stage0096_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop it, $$ハマーン$$!
　Deep down, you too, really...」

stage0096_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't intrude on my heart!」

stage0096_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$シャア$$!
　$$時空修復$$ is mine to carry out!
　And I'll have you on your knees for it!」

stage0096_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$クェス$$
「I won't let you touch the Colonel!」

stage0096_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$クェス$$
「You finally told me the truth, Colonel.」

stage0096_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$クェス$$...
　Even so, will you still come with me?」

stage0096_04:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$クェス$$
「I'm not like $$ハマーン$$.
　Because I believe in you, Colonel.」

stage0096_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$アムロ$$
「（But it's precisely because she's a child that $$クェス$$
　could be honest with herself.
　That's the difference between you and her, $$ハマーン$$...!）」

stage0096_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$クェス$$
「I'll back you up, Colonel.
　Let's beat both $$ハマーン$$ and $$フロンタル$$!」

stage0096_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$シャア$$!
　I'll settle this with you here on $$アクシズ$$!」

stage0096_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$シャア$$
「It can't be helped...!
　I'm getting through, $$ハマーン$$!」

stage0096_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Now the cast is all assembled.」

stage0096_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$!
　What kind of person are you...!」

stage0096_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Words won't reach him...!
　That mask is armor for a heart
　that refuses to understand anyone!」

stage0096_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$アムロ$$
「And as long as that mask exists,
　he'll keep playing $$シャア$$... the Red Comet within himself!」

stage0096_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'm not playing a role, $$アムロ$$.
　I am the Red Comet.」

stage0096_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I am the Spacenoids' hope,
　the one who will guide the world in the right direction...!」

stage0096_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's nothing but your own ego!」

stage0096_04:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Grr...!
　Am I going to lose!」

stage0096_04:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Damn...!
　I can't break free!」

stage0096_04:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$シャア$$
「As you are, you'll help me carry out $$時空修復$$!」

stage0096_04:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Do you think I'll agree to that, $$シャア$$?」

stage0096_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I have the resolve for humanity's future.
　Yes... enough to throw away this life of mine.」

stage0096_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「If one of the two singularities is lost, $$時空修復$$ can't be done!」

stage0096_04:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is it because you have no attachment to your own life
　that you can take the lives of others so easily!」

stage0096_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$! You...!」

stage0096_04:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「What's this, $$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　You'd already noticed there were two singularities?」

stage0096_04:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Even if you'd managed to carry out $$時空修復$$,
　I figured it'd end up half-finished...
　Seems I underestimated you.」

stage0096_04:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「The least you could do is thank me, $n.
　It's because I gave you the hint
　that you figured out about the singularities, isn't it?」

stage0096_04:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You too, $$シャア$$.
　Thanks to me, you flushed out the ticks
　infesting Earth and dragged them into war.」

stage0096_04:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$...!
　There is not a single thing I have to thank you for!」

stage0096_04:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Ah... I see...
　Then, how about this?」

stage0096_04:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$メラン$$
「$$アクシズ$$ is accelerating further!
　We're breaking past the point of no return!」

stage0096_04:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$シャア$$
「The preparations for $$時空修復$$ aren't ready yet!
　At this rate...!」

stage0096_04:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$アクシズ$$ will fall to Earth
　before we can destroy the Prison of Time!」

stage0096_04:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's all futile, $c.
　Just watch quietly as $$アクシズ$$ falls.」

stage0096_04:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...Sorry, but lend me everyone's lives...!」

stage0096_04:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$!
　Neither I, nor $c... nor humanity,
　will go the way you want!」

stage0096_04:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's just one little pebble, I'll push it away with the Gundam!」

stage0096_04:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「To think we'd retreat before the Colonel...!
　This is no way for the Personal Guard to behave!」

stage0096_04:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Forgive us, Colonel!
　We pray for your fortune in battle!」

stage0096_04:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Captain!
　The $$ガランシェール$$ can't take any more!」

stage0096_04:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$アレク$$
「This thing can't take a straight fight anymore!」

stage0096_04:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
（I've got no right to say this, but...）

stage0096_04:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
（Don't die on me, $$バナージ$$...）

stage0096_04:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Mr. $$ジンネマン$$...
　I guess we really do have to fight after all...）

stage0096_04:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Silence!
　You have no right to decide my life!」

stage0096_04:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$シャア$$
「Fall back, $$ハマーン$$!
　You're not allowed to die in a place like this!」

stage0096_04:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$シャア$$
「There was no lie in my words when I entrusted Zeon to you!
　Believe me, $$ハマーン$$!」

stage0096_04:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「She who cannot let go of being a woman,
　and you who cannot shake off the past make a fitting pair.」

stage0096_04:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$シャア$$
「Are there no women within you?」

stage0096_04:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Recoa Londe, $$ハマーン・カーン$$, $$ナナイ・ミゲル$$...
　And the two eternal women deep in your heart...」

stage0096_04:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I am not like you.
　I'm never swayed by feelings like that.」

stage0096_04:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$シャア$$
「A man who has never loved anyone
　has no business trying to change the world. That's pure ego!
　I can't let a man like that run free!」

stage0096_04:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$ヒル$$
「I can't let Neo Zeon's flagship go down!
　Fall back!」

stage0096_04:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$キタン$$
「Did you see that!?
　No matter how big a monster you bring,
　you're no match for us!」

stage0096_04:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$シモン$$
（Wait for me, $$ニア$$...!
　I'll protect the Earth you love, and I'll definitely come back for you!）

stage0096_04:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$フェルト$$
「In one minute, $$アクシズ$$ will pass the point of no return!」

stage0096_04:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, concentrate fire on $$フロンタル$$!
　We have to bring down the $$シナンジュ$$ in this one minute, no matter what!」

stage0096_04:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$メラン$$
「$$アクシズ$$ is crossing the point of no return!」

stage0096_04:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Unable to bring down $$フル・フロンタル$$,
　and unable to stop $$アクシズ$$...!」

stage0096_04:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$シャア$$
「At this rate, the $$時空修復$$...!」

stage0096_04:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I've won, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

stage0096_04:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$!
　You who showed disrespect to the Colonel, I will cut you down here!」

stage0096_04:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Is your own pride really that important, even in a situation like this!?」

stage0096_04:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You could never understand!
　The Colonel's greatness!」

stage0096_04:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「The Colonel alone is fit to lead this new world!」

stage0096_04:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I can't put it into words, but that man... he's dangerous!」

stage0096_04:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm going to stop him...!
　And to do that, I have to break through you!」

stage0096_04:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop it, $$ハマーン$$!
　Even you can't want a fight like this!」

stage0096_04:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't try to crawl inside my heart, $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0096_04:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Get out of my way!
　I must settle things with $$シャア$$!」

stage0096_04:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「He'll answer for what he's done, I'll make sure of it!
　But that comes after we protect the world's future!」

stage0096_04:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン$$!
　I won't let you cut him down!」

stage0096_04:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$シャア$$!
　You will pay for deceiving all of Neo Zeon!」

stage0096_04:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$シャア$$
「Wake up, $$ハマーン$$!
　If we defeat the Federation's Earth supremacists... Chrono,
　there's still a path to reconciliation between Earth and the colonies!」

stage0096_04:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then what of the Spacenoids' cries of resentment!?」

stage0096_04:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$シャア$$
「If we let that out, all that awaits us
　is an endless war of hatred!」

stage0096_04:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$シャア$$
「Does that serve humanity!?
　At this rate, humanity will never be able
　to move on to the next stage!」

stage0096_04:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「...Reason cannot suppress feeling...
　Perhaps that is simply human nature...」

stage0096_04:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「But you will still answer for this!
　As Neo Zeon's Supreme Commander, and as a man,
　atone for the sin of shirking your responsibility!」

stage0096_04:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$シャア$$
「Is it no use, $$ハマーン$$...!」

stage0096_04:r_7d9f085a5d9c51fd.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Please stand down, Mr. $$ジンネマン$$!
　Is this really how you mean to settle your grudge against Earth!?」

stage0096_04:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You can hear me, can't you, Mr. $$ジンネマン$$!
　Mr. $$フラスト$$, Mr. $$アレク$$!」

stage0096_04:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$フラスト$$
「...What do we do, Captain?」

stage0096_04:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「He's the enemy...
　Shoot him down.」

stage0096_04:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
（$$バナージ$$...I've come too far to turn back now...）

stage0096_04:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
（We can't stop anymore...
　We're just like that $$アクシズ$$.）

stage0096_04:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$シモン$$
「Wait for it, $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$!
　Once I'm done here, I'm coming
　straight for you, no matter what!」

stage0096_04:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$シモン$$
「And I'll take it all back, I swear it!
　$$ニア$$! And peace on Earth!!」

stage0096_04:r_69bf15620a355d50.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「No way I'm letting someone like you,
　who just goes along with anything, run Earth and the colonies!」

stage0096_04:r_ae4d9169d6ff43a4.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Children are meant to obey their elders.
　That is simply the natural order of the world.」

stage0096_04:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then if you lose to that child,
　that makes you lower than a kid!」

stage0096_04:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Watch closely, you fake Red Comet!
　We'll beat you and stop $$アクシズ$$ too!」

stage0096_04:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$タケル$$
「What is this...!
　I can definitely feel Captain $$クワトロ$$'s...
　$$シャア・アズナブル$$'s presence from that man!」

stage0096_04:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is because I am the one meant to inherit
　the true $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s consciousness.」

stage0096_04:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$タケル$$
「This is dangerous...!
　I have to stop him before the void this man carries
　swallows the world's future!」

stage0096_04:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A boy like you, who believes in his own justice,
　likely can't accept such a cruel reality.」

stage0096_04:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「I have no interest in listening to someone
　who turns away from that and tries to build
　a small, empty world instead!」

stage0096_04:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$正太郎$$
「What you're trying to do
　is just running away from hardship!
　I'd rather chase the future, no matter how painful!」

stage0096_04:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even if it's just an AT, this is no opponent to underestimate...!」

stage0096_04:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$キリコ$$
「It seems the only way to end this war
　is to strike you down.」

stage0096_04:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「So you'll come at me throwing caution to the wind, for that?」

stage0096_04:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Don't misunderstand.
　I have no intention of choosing death myself.」

stage0096_04:r_263097ee015a04ab.text:
$$キリコ$$
「And I don't intend to be an empty man like you, either.」

stage0096_04:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A battle between singularities...!
　Not something you see every day!」

stage0096_04:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$桂$$
「I don't want to be seen as one of your friends,
　you who abandoned responsibility to do as you please.」

stage0096_04:r_5135fdea02c6bd7b.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even with my shortcomings, I believe
　I am acting for the sake of the world.」

stage0096_04:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$桂$$
「That's not it.
　You're just deciding humanity's limits on your own
　and trying to force us into a narrow mold!」

stage0096_04:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$桂$$
「A man like that has no right
　to decide what happens to the world!」

stage0096_04:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Who you really are doesn't matter to me!
　You're an enemy that must be defeated!」

stage0096_04:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「In your heart, you accept $$シャア・アズナブル$$.
　And yet you say you won't accept me?」

stage0096_04:r_f2655371e3ef7b59.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「He'll have to settle things too, I'll make sure of it!
　But you're different...
　You're a man who doesn't care about anyone else's existence!」

stage0096_04:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Harsh words.
　But without being that kind of man,
　one cannot lead humanity into the coming age.」

stage0096_04:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't screw with me!
　I'll never accept a future led by a man like you!」

stage0096_04:r_54d7a668750123ea.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Let's settle this, $$アムロ$$!」

stage0096_04:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't know what your relation to $$シャア$$ is,
　but I have no intention of listening to words like that.」

stage0096_04:r_1d13d9bb6a6d7818.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Whatever it takes, my job is
　to stop you and repair spacetime...!」

stage0096_04:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even knowing that power is being exploited by the foolish masses?」

stage0096_04:r_9b8d839e83da7879.text:
$$アムロ$$
「There's no such thing as the 'foolish masses' you speak of, anywhere!
　You, who can coldly cast aside every life on Earth,
　we're the ones who will stop you!」

stage0096_04:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You are not the Red Comet!
　You're something other than human, wearing his skin!」

stage0096_04:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「If you too are a man who has fought for the colonies,
　you should understand the distortion Earth suffers from now.」

stage0096_04:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The Spacenoids cannot wait for that.
　That is why the Red Comet is needed.」

stage0096_04:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「The age of change through war should already be over.」

stage0096_04:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$...
　There is no future in the world you envision!」

stage0096_04:r_cc01b694a39de719.text:
$$シン$$
「The world can change without war!
　Why won't you choose that path!」

stage0096_04:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The world cannot hold on that way.
　The attacks by Geminis and $$バアル$$ are proof of that.」

stage0096_04:r_fa54b106906131ec.text:
$$シン$$
「Then all the more reason!
　This is no time for humanity to be fighting itself!」

stage0096_04:r_64f86b30363f1f4c.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Exactly right.
　That is why humanity needs a leader.」

stage0096_04:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$シン$$
「What kind of logic is that!?
　I can't hand this world over to someone
　who starts wars in the name of peace!」

stage0096_04:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text:
$$キラ$$
「Are you trying to drag
　$$プラント$$ into this war as well?」

stage0096_04:r_c5f074a439f6c890.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is their own will.」

stage0096_04:r_8b22d4b99ca35b84.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Put another way, it's simply that their latent dissatisfaction
　with Earth is beginning to surface.」

stage0096_04:r_b0aaf075b2a97a36.text:
$$キラ$$
「Are you the one guiding it?」

stage0096_04:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Even I am not that all-powerful.
　$$プラント$$'s affairs I leave to $$プラント$$'s own people.」

stage0096_04:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「What I must do now
　is guide this world in the right direction.」

stage0096_04:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$キラ$$
「A world without a future can't possibly be right!
　We're the ones who will stop you!」

stage0096_04:r_2b4d4dced3ef5a03.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「If you've awakened as an Innovator,
　you should understand that humanity too
　must advance toward something better.」

stage0096_04:r_d3ea963a3518a978.text:
$$刹那$$
「That is not something anyone should force!」

stage0096_04:r_0c888ad00ef30dc4.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Humanity cannot survive that way.
　Not in the future I have seen.」

stage0096_04:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$$刹那$$
「What must be done to change that cannot be war!」

stage0096_04:r_bee2bfb994ca7365.text:
$$刹那$$
「I won't let you, who abandoned the future,
　do as you please with this world!!」

stage0096_04:r_6d287e4652a3781f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You... what kind of person are you!」

stage0096_04:r_4d54e46ed7fd462d.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「It seems you too refuse to face reality,
　seeing only convenient dreams, $$バナージ$$.」

stage0096_04:r_1c42d2bca3a5e3a3.text:
$$バナージ$$
「What's wrong with looking past the present and dreaming of the future!
　I can't understand denying possibility instead!」

stage0096_04:r_b23f4e273f76c5a8.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A person capable of making that choice
　should be the one to govern this coming world.
　That is my answer.」

stage0096_04:r_6acc4cacd2cf56b6.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so, I will!
　I'll show you I can resist!!」

stage0096_04:r_0491c741ae20f5e6.text:
$$葵$$
「Ever since the first time we fought,
　there's just been something fishy about you.」

stage0096_04:r_131bea3d5d957e98.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That is likely because I was $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s shadow.」

stage0096_04:r_fc994d6aae0712cc.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But now that he is gone,
　I will lead the world as the true Red Comet.」

stage0096_04:r_18ef8ab6be368d72.text:
$$葵$$
「Cut the theatrical act!
　Let's hear your real feelings!」

stage0096_04:r_176fd2544c64e83e.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Say what you will, but these are my true, unfeigned feelings.」

stage0096_04:r_ae2ea53f43e74074.text:
$$葵$$
「Then I'll smash that mask of yours to pieces,
　and show me the real you!!」

stage0096_04:r_60e8a3284b8a113b.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Is this really the time for stuffy speeches!?
　We're almost at the climax here!」

stage0096_04:r_d4164c459c1c1165.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「You're a free man, aren't you, $$熱気バサラ$$.」

stage0096_04:r_e745974656b70e6a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But freedom always comes with a price.
　In your case, that price is being cast out by the world.」

stage0096_04:r_f794dabe545dc6ac.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Even if the world ignores me, I'll still sing!
　To make my voice echo across the world!」

stage0096_04:r_d4f3fe1e9bcf2590.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go, $$フル・フロンタル$$!
　You're gonna liiisten to my song too!!」

stage0096_04:r_59cb6a337266e5c9.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'll defeat you right here and put an end
　to the legend of the Red Comet!」

stage0096_04:r_3888ccd5f98dd99d.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Can you really do that?」

stage0096_04:r_521653467873650f.text:
$$アルト$$
「I will!
　Unlike you, who threw everything aside,
　I have things I carry... things I must protect!」

stage0096_04:r_aab85855cbaf5596.text:
$$アルト$$
「I won't lose to some hollow man
　who has nothing left but the name Red Comet!」

stage0096_04:r_e5f4d0fca11502fa.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Here I come, you fake!
　I'll catch you and put an end to this fight!」

stage0096_04:r_f3ed55718d2364ba.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Now that the Red Comet has fallen,
　I've taken up that name myself.」

stage0096_04:r_47fd2ac2e2a8e945.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「And that light will come to guide
　not just the Spacenoids, but all of mankind.」

stage0096_04:r_95ef381ed0b96982.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Guys who try to set themselves up
　above everyone else are never worth a damn!」

stage0096_04:r_82218191e135e576.text:
$$竜馬$$
「At least I'll prove
　you're nowhere near $$シャア・アズナブル$$ in a fight!」

stage0096_04:r_c4e4b578079583c5.text:
$$甲児$$
「You're nothing like Captain $$クワトロ$$!
　I can't feel any warmth in your words at all!」

stage0096_04:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
$$甲児$$
「Your words have no fire to move anyone!
　It's like you're reading someone else's script!」

stage0096_04:r_04169fb070591784.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's the will of the people
　who entrusted their future to the Red Comet.
　I'm merely the vessel that gathers it.」

stage0096_04:r_1be6bea3e5d25074.text:
$$甲児$$
「A vessel as shallow as yours
　can't hold anyone's heart!
　I'll smash that half-baked vessel of yours!!」

stage0096_04:r_2471e14c1ef0ecac.text:
$$赤木$$
「Do you even get it!?
　If you drop that thing on Earth,
　it'll become a dead world no one can live on!」

stage0096_04:r_6c3c0ada303bce08.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「And then humanity will move its home
　completely into space, and a new era will begin.」

stage0096_04:r_9f5a27f5febf371b.text:
$$赤木$$
「Is it fine to end the present age just for that!?
　Do you have the right to decide such a thing!?」

stage0096_04:r_c5d536c5ba8c0902.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I'm merely carrying out the correct history.」

stage0096_04:r_243595675818fcae.text:
$$赤木$$
「History, the future, none of it is set in stone!
　That's why everyone lives their hardest,
　trying to make the world even a little better!」

stage0096_04:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$赤木$$
「I won't let some guy who doesn't get that
　do whatever the hell he pleases!!」

stage0096_04:r_2e966de2770bb703.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I've seen a glimpse
　of this 'correct world' you speak of.」

stage0096_04:r_ddda297a7997c73b.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「You're a resident of Paradigm City, then?」

stage0096_04:r_02c89111c680d125.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A desolate, dead world...
　I refuse to call something like that correct!」

stage0096_04:r_fda7edf39e317875.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's not for you to decide.」

stage0096_04:r_b267a0ec877acc0e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「And it's not for you either!」

stage0096_04:r_c627120a60cde94d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ビッグオー$$ and I
　will stop you, the one who'd steal that choice away!」

stage0096_04:r_22a2d3667e5a9fc8.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$ゼロ$$...
　You of all people understand
　that changing the world requires pain, don't you?」

stage0096_04:r_3f09ae47d355cbc5.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$!
　That's exactly why I'll stop you myself!」

stage0096_04:r_629b0e87b7bc7b76.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「And I'll teach you this!
　That there's no life
　that's fine to sacrifice for changing the world!」

stage0096_04:r_5777cb06f7e0103f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「An AS can't stop this $$シナンジュ$$.」

stage0096_04:r_98e716ed18b1b3a2.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Not a single wasted word, is it.
　It seems you're quite the excellent soldier.」

stage0096_04:r_91a4ece3cc02badd.text:
$$宗介$$
「At the very least, I'd like to think I'm a better soldier
　than a man who relies on his machine's specs
　and acts so at ease on the battlefield.」

stage0096_04:r_e83ac0db54ff2b02.text:
$$宗介$$
「The moment you clung to the legend of the Red Comet
　and came out to the front line,
　your defeat was already decided...!」

stage0096_04:r_bc5b33fbc100b97b.text:
$$宗介$$
「I won't let you drop a chunk of rock like that
　onto the Earth where my school is!」

stage0096_04:r_f2d72b948cc38cfe.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll protect the Earth, I swear it!
　That's the promise I made to my mom and dad!」

stage0096_04:r_3b207a6e3b8e5700.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「With a shortsighted way of thinking like yours,
　the world will end up heading toward ruin.」

stage0096_04:r_718d4f86b37b2915.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I won't accept some future for the world
　dreamed up by a man who'd throw away someone's life!」

stage0096_04:r_2cd57aac659672dc.text:
$$アマタ$$
「A person's life isn't some number!
　Don't you dare think you can raise or lower it so easily!!」

stage0096_04:r_017c609cb5528ca1.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「You, who only drifted into this world,
　have no right to stop what I'm trying to do.」

stage0096_04:r_984737d2920b03f7.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm living in this world too!
　As one life among many,
　I have something to say to you!」

stage0096_04:r_5ce10ef5943775df.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「A life once lost never comes back!
　If you can't understand that,
　then I'll be the one to face you!」

stage0096_04:r_444bfe868b096710.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「With that huge body of yours,
　you won't be able to keep pace with me and $$シナンジュ$$.」

stage0096_04:r_864ee68806b41af1.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「My anger becomes $$ガンバスター$$'s flame!
　It can never, ever be stopped!
　No matter who I'm up against!!」

stage0096_04:r_5c69712b1b3fb77b.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「There's also the matter of the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$.
　I'll have you disappear.」

stage0096_04:r_f8c886fa821c5334.text:
$$シモン$$
「Their goal is the annihilation of mankind!
　This isn't just a problem for me alone!」

stage0096_04:r_a4366814d6972533.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But once you, their frontrunner, are erased,
　and $$エタニティ・フラット$$ is completed besides,
　they'll be satisfied.」

stage0096_04:r_2e5685a3629d0a5e.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Understand this.
　I am taking action in order to save the world.」

stage0096_04:r_ce4b924038c181a0.text:
$$シモン$$
「What you're trying to do
　is the same as the Spiral King of old!
　That's nothing but running away!」

stage0096_04:r_1054a335fa977a7a.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't think a guy like that can stop me!
　Whatever it is you're trying to pull,
　my drill's gonna punch clean through it!!」

stage0096_04:r_1795607640d74fdb.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「There's no need to push yourself.」

stage0096_04:r_b302a6e2e0ca76ec.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「You're standing on this battlefield
　while fighting your own fear right now.
　Someone like that has no need to force himself to fight.」

stage0096_04:r_e4166e8a5b45cb96.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Someone who only ever says kind words like that...
　I can't bring myself to trust them.」

stage0096_04:r_bdfc9cb5d9aaf4ce.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Everyone who's ever helped me
　is someone fighting past their own pain and suffering!
　That's why I can fight alongside them too!」

stage0096_04:r_cb789b091a7a05ca.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's unfortunate.
　And here I was advising you to fall back.」

stage0096_04:r_5430d9d76e38cf47.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll fight too!
　I have things I want to protect as well!」

stage0096_04:r_1711e6c6939aa411.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「So there's another foolish soldier here too,
　one who's misjudged his own strength?」

stage0096_04:r_1efac5b6d8fb1238.text:
$n
「Which one's the bigger fool, I wonder,
　some guy who doesn't even know his own worth
　trying to fix the world however he likes, or me.」

stage0096_04:r_63bcb74b5bb605c9.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The sharper your tongue, the less charm you have...!」

stage0096_04:r_b661c876eb7a4d72.text:
$n
「Even if he was branded a traitor,
　$$シャア$$, who kept resisting Geminis and Chrono,
　is a different man from you, after all!」

stage0096_04:r_99128140e453d460.text:
$n
「I can't let someone like you
　have the title of Red Comet,
　the name that belongs to the strongest pilot!」

stage0096_04:r_bdf41f6a0fb7b286.text:
$$シャア$$
「So, in the end, it's come to this.」

stage0096_04:r_3e40a7aae6a7ebad.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Apparently, the same person
　from parallel worlds
　can't normally exist in the same world.」

stage0096_04:r_d4488f1ef5175d87.text:
$$シャア$$
「So you're telling me
　that you and I are to fight
　over who holds the title of Red Comet?」

stage0096_04:r_4f98756e8506f766.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「It simply means that two people alike
　tend to repel one another.」

stage0096_04:r_722be3d36da4979c.text:
$$シャア$$
「How unpleasant,
　being likened to a man like you.」

stage0096_04:r_4f838d45a89974f0.text:
$$シャア$$
「I have a fair idea where you come from...!
　But that has nothing to do with this fight!」

stage0096_04:r_99e939138611b349.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$トレーズ$$ and $$ゼロ$$ both, though their means differed,
　shared one thing in common:
　they fought believing in the future of the world!」

stage0096_04:r_b8aead2ff492ad33.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's no different for me either.」

stage0096_04:r_e18660f45e2bdaae.text:
$$シャア$$
「No, you're wrong, $$フロンタル$$.
　You aren't seeking any future at all!」

stage0096_04:r_f2a506c32c68b595.text:
$$シャア$$
「You've finally shown some raw emotion.」

stage0096_04:r_366eed12d0fa7297.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Do you want to make me angry that badly,
　$$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

stage0096_04:r_db902169b0ec12e0.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$フロンタル$$!
　One who leads mankind must be human himself!」

stage0096_04:r_53dd6bae12e095c3.text:
$$シャア$$
「I won't hand the world to something like you!
　You'll become a sacrificial pillar for $$時空修復$$,
　right alongside me!」

stage0096_04:r_888c0b4c627ecec4.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The masked me and the man in a costume...
　who'd have thought we'd cross paths like this.」

stage0096_04:r_96d6ee6ffbd6d1e6.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I see...
　The so-called 'man inside'... you're saying the self
　that has a will of its own is different from me...」

stage0096_04:r_83e0e74db0ae4d4f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But you go out to fight in that thing
　because someone wished you would...
　which makes you just like me, who gathered the Spacenoids' wishes.」

stage0096_04:r_d45ebbbfa8153f69.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Very well!
　If you're going to deny me,
　then show me this will of yours!」
